dogecoin.text: @business On the contrary, Dogecoin is still a joke. As its comedic value fades away, its price will decline, eventually to zero, which ironically will be quite funny.

@business "crypto purists" (if that is a thing) should fear dogecoin, not because it's a distraction from their "grand project", (if that is a thing), but rather because it brings focus on the reality that all cryptocurrency prices are driven mostly by irrational exuberance.

@nmasc_ Dogecoin speculators who manage to get out before it goes to zero could dominate some of the whackier segments of the startup world. It would be fun thinking up businesses that would appeal to that crowd.
